facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife preferred a transfer petition under Section 24 of CPC for transferring the case from Family Court, Udaipur to Family Court No.1, Jodhpur.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial proceedings, the convenience of the wife has to be considered for contesting the suit.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Vinisha Jitesh Tolani @ Manmeet Laghmani vs Jitesh Kishore Tolani 2010(1) WLC (SC) 705 has observed that
cited_cases: Vinisha Jitesh Tolani @ Manmeet Laghmani vs Jitesh Kishore Tolani, 2010(1) WLC (SC) 705

legal_principles.principle: Matrimonial proceedings ought to be transferred where the wife is residing.
legal_principles.held: Accordingly, the matrimonial proceedings ought to be transferred where the wife is residing.
cited_cases: Vinisha Jitesh Tolani @ Manmeet Laghmani vs Jitesh Kishore Tolani, 2010(1) WLC (SC) 705

outcome.final_order: The civil case was transferred to Family Court No.1, Jodhpur, and both parties were directed to appear before the court on 16.10.2023.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
